name: PCI-DSS 4.0 — Network Segmentation
description: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard v4.0 network segmentation and access control requirements for devices in cardholder data environments.

rules.name: No default credentials
rules.description: PCI-DSS 2.1: Default passwords and community strings must be changed before deployment

rules.name: Encrypted management access
rules.description: PCI-DSS 4.1: All management access must use strong cryptography (no telnet, no HTTP without TLS)

rules.name: No weak encryption in VPN
rules.description: PCI-DSS 4.1: VPN configurations must not use DES, 3DES, or MD5

rules.name: ACLs on all external interfaces
rules.description: PCI-DSS 1.3: Access control lists must be applied on interfaces facing untrusted networks

rules.name: Logging to remote server
rules.description: PCI-DSS 10.2: Audit logging must be sent to a centralized log server

rules.name: NTP for accurate timestamps
rules.description: PCI-DSS 10.4: Time synchronization must be configured for accurate audit trails

rules.name: AAA authentication
rules.description: PCI-DSS 8.1: Individual user authentication must be enforced via AAA

rules.name: SSH version 2 only
rules.description: PCI-DSS 4.1: Only SSHv2 connections are permitted for management access

rules.name: HTTPS only for web management
rules.description: PCI-DSS 4.1: If web management is enabled, it must use HTTPS only

rules.name: No unused interfaces active
rules.description: PCI-DSS 1.1.6: Unused interfaces should be administratively shut down
